Most photographs on this site are by photographers who share their work on Wikimedia Commons under Creative Commons licences or in the public domain. We are grateful to them. Each is listed below with its author, licence and source; select a photograph to see the original. Photographs shown with a licence ending in SA are shared under the same licence. Our own illustrations and photographs are not listed.

If you are the author of a photograph here and would like the credit changed, write to talaashheritage@gmail.com.
